svg.text: MSA-aligned exon architecture · one primary protein per species
Where do the coding exons of the selected primary proteins fall on a common alignment coordinate, and which exon intervals are matched across species?
MSA column of the cross-species primary-protein alignment
Coding exon, aligned interval matched in every species
Coding exon without a matched interval in some species
Alignment extent (gap columns carry no exon)
A shared column means the residues were aligned, not that they are functionally equivalent. Vertical ticks mark coding-exon ends on the alignment axis.
